title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Baba Lokenath
desc: Baba Loknath, an Indian saint, helps people through his miracles. He spends his life seeking enlightenment and finally attains Samadhi.

title: Dolon Chapa
desc: Charan is a simple and honest man who is accused of a crime. Instead of accepting his fate, he fights for his innocence and tries to be acquitted of all charges.

title: Pratisodh
desc: Ranjan is sent to jail under false allegations by his uncle. However, he strives to take revenge and teach his uncle a lesson.

title: Ek Chiltey Sindoor
desc: Gita, a widow, resides with her two children and owns a large estate. However, when her father's friend cheats and murders him, she sets out to settle scores.

title: 100 Percent Love
desc: Competitive peers Balu and Mahalakshmi have ego clashes while in college. When they meet again after a few years, they try to outdo each other until they realise that they are in love.
